title: Monetizing Intelligence: Advertising and Subscription Design on LLM Platforms
abstract: arXiv:2610.32945v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) platforms introducing advertising must decide how much capability ad revenue should fund and what consumers should pay to avoid ads. We study a monopolistic platform that jointly chooses costly response quality, advertising intensity, and subscription prices when advertising reduces user value but better service raises advertising returns. Three findings follow. First, when partly ad-supported and ad-free plans coexist, advertising can finance useful service for consumers who receive none under pure subscription. Lower effective quality in middle plans weakens the alternatives available to premium users, allowing higher prices for unchanged ad-free service. Some fully ad-supported users gain utility, while partly ad-supported and ad-free users lose: broader access can coexist with utility polarization. translated_title: 智能变现：大语言模型平台上的广告与订阅设计
translated_abstract: 引入广告的大语言模型（LLM）平台必须决定广告收入应资助多少能力，以及消费者需要支付多少费用才能免于广告。我们研究了一个垄断平台，在广告会降低用户价值、但更好的服务能提升广告回报的条件下，如何联合选择有成本约束的响应质量、广告强度和订阅价格。研究得出三个发现。第一，当部分广告支持型方案与无广告方案共存时，广告可以为那些在纯订阅模式下无法获得服务的消费者提供资金支持。中间档位方案较低的实用质量削弱了高级用户可用的替代选择，从而允许平台在无广告服务不变的情况下收取更高价格。部分完全由广告支持的用户获得了效用，而部分广告支持和无广告用户则遭受损失：更广泛的接入可以与效用两极分化并存。第二，适度的广告上限可以通过保留部分收入来最大化消费者剩余（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 该论文研究大语言模型平台的广告与订阅联合定价设计，发现广告既能资助更广泛的服务接入，但也会导致用户效用两极分化，而设置适度的广告上限可以最大化消费者剩余。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the joint design of advertising, response quality, and subscription pricing on LLM platforms, showing that advertising can finance broader access while causing utility polarization, and that an intermediate advertising cap can maximize consumer surplus.
